newsitem.title: USA: AEP says European sales adversely affected.
newsitem.headline: AEP says European sales adversely affected.

text.p: AEP Industries Inc Thursday said first quarter North American and Asia-Pacific sales were slightly ahead, but European sales were adversely affected by a strong dollar.
The Company noted that 1997 first quarter sales and net income were as planned.

Net sales for the 1997 first quarter were $192,855,000 versus $54,770,000 for the same period of 1996. Income from operations increased to $10,438,000 from $7,089,000 in the 1996 first quarter. Net income was $4,056,000 compared with $3,205,000 in the prior year quarter.

Earnings per share in the first quarter of 1997 were $0.54 versus $0.64 last year, on a 50.5 percent increase in the weighted average shares outstanding, which reached 7,499,503 shares in the latest quarter.

Sales in North America and Asia-Pacific were slightly ahead of last year on a combined, pro forma basis, while European sales were adversely affected by the currency exchange effect of a strong U.S. dollar, the company said.

"We made important progress in the first quarter in our integration and cost reduction program at BGP and are generally ahead of schedule in merging these operations," said Brendan Barba, chairman and chief executive officer of AEP.
"At the same time, we remain committed to the pallet wrap business and expect conditions in this industry to improve in North America in the near future.
Meanwhile, we are moving forward with our plans to expand AEP's presence in pallet wrap internationally. We see exciting opportunities worldwide."
